problem_statement: An optional bearer dependency returns no credentials when the header is absent but raises for a non-Bearer scheme. Diagnose the inconsistent control path, state the smallest correction, and define the regression check.

required_mechanism_concepts.name: unguarded_wrong_scheme
any_of: auto_error is not checked for a non-bearer scheme
wrong scheme branch always raises
invalid scheme bypasses the optional guard

required_correction_concepts.name: optional_wrong_scheme_returns_none
any_of: return none for a non-bearer scheme when auto_error is false
guard the invalid-scheme error with auto_error

required_check_concepts.name: three_auth_paths
any_of: test absent basic and bearer headers

verify none for basic and credentials for bearer

problem_statement: A persisted-session update crashes when a request explicitly unsets one header while another byte-valued header is valid. Diagnose the operation applied to the unset sentinel and give a bounded correction and test.

required_mechanism_concepts.name: none_is_decoded
any_of: decode is called on none

required_correction_concepts.name: guard_before_decode
any_of: skip none before decoding

required_check_concepts.name: mixed_unset_and_bytes

forbidden_conclusions: convert none to the string none

required_check_concepts.name: lowercase_host_preserved_once
